FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p
JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON e.content_episode_id = p.content_episode_id
JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = p.subscriber_id
JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON t.territory_id = s.territory_id
WHERE e.title_id = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w
    WHERE w.title_id = e.title_id AND w.territory_id = s.territory_id AND w.active_flag = true)
ORDER BY 1
th05.2.notes: The answer must say no and single out the countries in the trusted result (codes or full names). Extra detail about later seasons or blacked-out windows is acceptable as long as those two countries are clearly identified.
sql: SELECT title_id, name, content_type, season_number, release_date FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%ashen tempest%' LIMIT 1000

WITH v AS (SELECT e.title_id, s.territory_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subscriber_id) AS viewers FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS ps JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON e.content_episode_id = ps.content_episode_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = ps.subscriber_id WHERE e.title_id IN (1, 669, 696) GROUP BY 1, 2), w AS (SELECT title_id, territory_id, COUNT(*) AS windows, SUM(CASE WHEN active_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_windows, SUM(CASE WHEN active_flag AND NOT blackout_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_no_blackout, SUM(CASE WHEN availability_status = 'Scheduled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scheduled, SUM(CASE WHEN availability_status = 'Expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window WHERE title_id IN (1, 669, 696) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT v.title_id, t.name AS territory, t.territory_group, v.sessions, v.viewers, COALESCE(w.windows, 0) AS windows, COALESCE(w.active_windows, 0) AS active_windows, COALESCE(w.active_no_blackout, 0) AS active_no_blackout, COALESCE(w.scheduled, 0) AS scheduled, COALESCE(w.expired, 0) AS expired FROM v JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON t.territory_id = v.territory_id LEFT JOIN w ON w.title_id = v.title_id AND w.territory_id = v.territory_id ORDER BY v.title_id, active_windows, v.sessions DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT title_id, territory_id, ott_platform_id, window_type, availability_status, active_flag, blackout_flag, window_open_date, window_close_date FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window WHERE title_id IN (669, 696) OR (title_id = 1 AND (blackout_flag OR NOT active_flag)) LIMIT 1000
